01 Product · Interface systems

An observability console people actually read

Turned a wall of raw telemetry into a calm, legible surface engineers trust during incidents.

Role
Design engineering, front-end architecture
Scope
Interface system, data modeling, live-streaming UI
Year
2024

The starting point was a dense internal tool that showed everything and communicated nothing. The work was less about adding features and more about deciding what deserved attention during the worst ten minutes of someone’s week.

I reframed the console around a small vocabulary of states, a strict typographic hierarchy, and streaming updates that never moved content under the reader’s eyes.

Note on confidentiality

Client and product names are withheld. The work described is real; the specifics are generalized out of respect for the teams involved.
